name: Trend pullback (moving averages)
description: Join an established trend on a pullback to a moving average or prior structure, entering on a continuation candle.
markets: FX majors, indices, liquid stocks, crypto majors

plan.summary: Trends persist more often than they reverse; pullbacks give a better price with a tight stop.
plan.bias: Price above a rising 50 EMA for longs (below a falling one for shorts); higher highs and higher lows.
plan.setup: A pullback into the 20/50 EMA zone or a prior breakout level.
plan.entry: Close of a continuation candle (engulfing / pin bar) back in the trend direction.
plan.stop: Below the pullback low (above the high for shorts).
plan.no_trade: Flat EMAs / ranging market; less than 30 minutes before high-impact news.

fields.label: Trend strength
fields.guide: Read from swing structure on the trend timeframe.

fields.label: Pullback depth (% of last leg)
fields.guide: Retracement of the last impulse leg, 0–1 (0.5 = 50%).

rules.text: Clear trend on the higher timeframe
Entry only after the trigger candle closed
